entries.title: Psalms 75:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. 'Destroy not.' A Psalm of Asaph: a Song.>> Unto thee we give thanks, O God, we give thanks; and thy name is near: thy marvellous works declare it.

entries.title: Psalms 75:2
segments: When I shall receive the assembly, I will judge with equity.

entries.title: Psalms 75:3
segments: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I have established its pillars. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 75:4
segments: I said unto the boastful, Boast not; and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

entries.title: Psalms 75:5
segments: Lift not up your horn on high; speak not arrogantly with a [stiff] neck.

entries.title: Psalms 75:6
segments: ¶For not from the east nor from the west, nor yet from the south doth exaltation [come]:

entries.title: Psalms 75:7
segments: For God is the judge; he putteth down one and exalteth another.

entries.title: Psalms 75:8
segments: For in the hand of Jehovah there is a cup, and it foameth with wine, it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same; yea, the dregs thereof shall all the wicked of the earth drain off, [and] drink.

entries.title: Psalms 75:9
segments: But as for me, I will declare for ever; I will sing psalms to the God of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 75:10
segments: And all the horns of the wicked will I cut off; [but] the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
